reviews.title: Contact Us Function
reviews.text: How convenient, this was purchased in error by my minor niece and I want a refund so I tap the contact us link on ur app and it won’t open. Now Apple sees this as an overdue balance and I can’t purchase anything on my phone. Please refund my debit card. Also, you honestly charge people $34.99 to use an icon changer app? All the others are $8.99 or under. Total scam.

reviews.title: Use Something Else
reviews.text: There are just way better apps. I wanted to try out the subscription so I clicked on the 0.67 a week option and they charged me 30$ for a year. All of the customer service links in the app are broken. You can’t get all of the app icons in themes; you can only choose certain app links. If you choose a theme, they make you web links for the app instead of a bookmark or new picture, so when you click on the app, it takes you to a web page real quick and then to the app. I guess if you want to make your own theme, you could use this app, but there are better apps for that. Just get themify or make your own.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work well on iOS 26
reviews.text: Good templates and the ability to make transparent widgets is great, but the app hasn’t been updated to work with the new iOS 26 customization options on the home screen. Using the tinted or clear icon options result in a white box instead of the widget. This should be addressed in an update that allows the widgets to show up in these new customization modes of iOS.
